scientific_integrity: Analytic all-dimension proof plus independent finite exact combinatorial and complete small-alphabet checks; finite checks do not imply the general proof. Prior first and second moments credited explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-cut purity only, not multi-cut averaged purity
Independent uniform phases only; not Haar-random amplitudes
No full probability law or central limit theorem
Closest September preprint full text unavailable for exhaustive comparison
title: Exact third purity cumulants and a cubic-root resonance in random Hadamard states
